final_checkpoint: fixed last step; do not select by exam or best seed
retina: 2 boards, 8 by 12 per board, mean absolute color change pooled over 8x8 camera pixels, fixed gain 4, clip 0..1; 16 levels during feedback
motor: scalar electrical port: <-0.35 drives left, >0.35 drives right, otherwise rest; physical device converts one sign to one 4px vertical stroke, no search
train_experience: home-side rehearsal followed by formal operation; independent recorded lapses probability .08, prior-failure reset-and-correction, passive externally actuated matched trajectory; outcome never fed before a choice
motor_primary: on active familiar trials: P(natural correct and relevant transplant causes opposite correct-for-donor drive) minus same event for an irrelevant transplant. Minimum 0.10, layout-paired 95% CI lower>0, positive in >=2 seeds; require factual task lower CI>0.60 and fixed provisional drive strict twin-group motion accuracy>0.50. A true physical signal plus dependence in THIS architecture, not proof of brain mechanism.
motor_additional: report familiar and held-out middle singleton; unaltered scene under mistaken transplant; goal swap, fixed drive goal sensitivity, no-drive/passive, terminal sensory accuracy, direct and disconnected-aux controls. Direction not just arbitrary flips.
language_primary: counterexample to necessity of the specified overt compositional port for this task if learned nonlinguistic 3-bit arm reaches >0.75 action accuracy at both depths 6 and 8 for >=2 seeds. Report paired accuracy and symbol-minus-latent effect even on failure. Same number of bits, cards and recurrent updates. No natural-language or consciousness inference.
language_secondary: same frozen net: clear scratch each round; swap one pre-final scratch with physical twin donor; shuffled symbols. Compare paired final nonverbal switch decisions, not explanatory text. Truthful report, arbitrary bijection code and learned hard bits are distinct.
statistics: two-sided percentile cluster bootstrap 6000 draws, seed 80119; resample independent base layouts or circuit pairs with trained seeds held fixed; show individual seeds. No pooling choices as iid.
holdout_policy: Obtain apparatus/shape checks on train seeds only. Protocol deposited before fitting or reading held-out outcomes. No test-driven retries; implementation corrections with evidence documented.
boundaries: World ontology and absence of subjective consciousness are not identifiable in a simulator. No object mask labels, effect comparator or external planner in autonomous execution. Motor and report ports, recurrence clock, fixed grammar, imposed training curriculum and physical actuators are designed. A private repository timestamp is not independent public preregistration.
